description:
Confronted with a new aquatic-based environment, Neon has decided to walk a hybrid path of both firepower and waterpower.
This spitfire goes all out on everything, whether it be honing her waterpower abilities, or having fun on vacation.

lines.text: Master! Do you want to recharge our waterpower together?
I'm a double agent pretending to be a spy on vacation.

Since we're at the ocean, I've gotta switch up my attributes... *Gulp, gulp, gulp*
All done!

Are you going back to the beach for round two?
I'll join you once my waterpower is fully charged.
My main go-to is firepower, but I think I can learn to appreciate waterpower as well.
Despite all the temptation splayed out on the beach, I'm still your only disciple.
The water flows, like a raging river... I know everything you're doing is to help me in my growth.
You're feeling heat exhaustion? Should I fetch you some water?
Your shower's broken? I'll take care of it!
There's somewhere in the Outpost perfect for honing my waterpower. It's the swimming pool!
This inner tube is no ordinary flotation device. You could put an elephant on top of this thing, and it'd still stay afloat.
On land, my prowess is firepower. Underwater, it is waterpower, for I am Hybrid Neon.
Now I can shoot out stronger streams of water.
Waterpower enhanced!
Feel the high pressure of my water gun.
Is this is a special gift, since I'm part of the Counters? I'll take it!
Wow, is this for me?
Thanks Master, you're like totally the coolest!
I'm so happy to be here with you, Master.
Let's you and I walk forward, hand in hand, toward that great beyond.
It doesn't matter whether you're dry or soaking wet, I'll admire you all the same.
Need my water gun?
Waterpower!
Waterpower! Waterpower!
Time to soak these suckers!
Water bomb, ready!
You'll be soaked within 10 seconds flat!
Are you ready for what's coming?
Master, do you trust me?
Waterpower, recharge!
A storm's coming when I'm done here!
Here comes the big one!
Feast your eyes upon my overflowing waterpower!
Let the tide wash them away!
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Anyone else need a good soak?
That's one more down the drain.
Gah!
Waterpower!
My swimsuit!
It's my own fault. I didn't use enough water.
Just call me Neon, the Aqua Master!
